citation.authors: Buxton OM, Pavlova M, Reid EW, Wang W, Simonson DC, Adler GK
citation.title: Sleep Restriction for 1 Week Reduces Insulin Sensitivity in Healthy Men

population.description: Twenty healthy men who completed the study (11 placebo, 9 modafinil), mean +/- SD age 26.8 +/- 5.2 y and BMI 23.3 +/- 3.1 kg/m2 for all 20 (Results, Subjects); the two findings are about the 11 placebo-group men and the 9 modafinil-group men at their sleep-replete baseline (after 10 h nights, before any drug: modafinil or placebo was given only during the 7 nights of sleep restriction). Age and BMI of the two groups separately are not printed, so the pooled figures are used.

protocols.name: clamp_morning
protocols.description: Euglycaemic-hyperinsulinaemic clamp on the morning after the sleep-replete baseline nights (10 h in bed), after an overnight fast, alone; the night is not entered. Insulin infused as human insulin at priming doses of 80 and 60 mU/m2 per min over the first two 5-min periods, then 40 mU/m2 per min for 170 min (an infusion rate, not entered as such); insulin level held at 57.8 uU/mL (mean serum insulin during the infusions, all subjects and both sleep conditions pooled) and serum glucose held at 90 mg/dL (the stated target) from T = 0 to T = 180 min (samples every 5 min to 180, hence 181 simulated minutes). Clock time of the clamp and hours of fasting are not given and are assumed (08:00, 10 h).

protocols.name: rmr_morning
protocols.description: Resting metabolic rate on waking in the sleep-replete condition: awake, in bed, after a 12-h fast (stated), no meal. Indirect calorimetry at about 08:20 (stated '~0820 h') for about 12-14 min (stated). Arm starts at 08:00 (assumed clock hour) so minute 20 is 08:20; it ends at minute 33, i.e. 13 min (midpoint of 12-14, assumed) of measurement; the window is that measurement. The night is not entered.
